method: Independent frame-by-frame review of source native PNG pixels, native-size full scenes, previews and result screenshots. No continuous playback or performance claim.
accepted: Blue hood, face, clothes, quiver, bow and hand ownership remain consistent.
Recovery bow length correction stays stable in both native facings.
Arrow/string visible at nock/draw, arrow absent at release.
Articulated arm poses, stable support during shot, acceptable move-to-shot and ready-to-idle handoff.
Target impact occurs as the arrow disappears from the bow.
limits: No visible travelling projectile; existing impact FX is not projectile flight.
Target impact partially covers target; no source occlusion in accepted two layouts.
All scenery/actor overlap arrangements, exported performance and complete campaign not accepted here.
additionalMoveRight: 74 observations retained as route/timing coverage; not counted as left-facing or independent visual acceptance.
